facts.fact: The health ministry's sector policy letter 2025-2029 states that a national strategic plan 2022-2026 for the health and social information system (SISS) is in force and that work is under way to integrate routine data in a national data warehouse on the DHIS2 platform, which it describes as the channel for routine health statistics; undated, so the letter's date of 25 March 2025 is used.

The health ministry states that retention of data by health unions, recurrent although recently lifted, together with union boycotts of activities, produces very low levels of availability, timeliness, completeness and accuracy of health data; it gives no figures and no date, so the letter's date of 25 March 2025 is used.

The sector policy letter 2025-2029 names the shared single patient record as the flagship project of the Health System Digitalisation Programme 2023-2029 and sets, under its action 1.6, the generalisation of the computerised patient record, with an indicator counting the hospitals, health centres and health posts delivering it; the letter's date of 25 March 2025 is used.

The health ministry (MSAS) presents the shared single patient record platform as its own project, part of its health digitalisation programme, with the contract awarded to a local company run by young Senegalese entrepreneurs, which it does not name; the letter's date of 25 March 2025 is used.

The health ministry states that deployment of the shared single patient record platform is in progress, without saying in how many facilities or where; undated, so the letter's date of 25 March 2025 is used.
